stable.notes:
Hibiscus 0.8.19 makes everyday note capture and editing more reliable.

- Quick Capture now saves consistently, including during first-time setup.
- New notes stay clean and temporary until you actually start writing.
- Rapid typing no longer loses the end of the first sentence.
- Archived notes can be restored by clicking the complete row.
- Activity now counts words written from a fresh blank note.
- Shortcut settings detect conflicts across Quick Capture, AI Actions, transformations, and app commands.
- AI readiness, permissions, update checks, and manual QA builds now report and isolate their state more accurately.
- Expanded native macOS regression coverage for note creation, Quick Capture, archive restore, Settings, onboarding, and rapid note switching.
